as_told.title: Brain waves used to guide ICBMs

plain: A man named Philip J. Corso is said to have claimed that, in the 1950s, the military tried to use recovered alien technology to steer machines by thought. Michels says Corso "claimed to be at the Pentagon in the '50s doling out UFO material" to private companies. An online researcher known as UAPGerb repeats Corso's account on the show. In his version, the Foreign Technology Division, an Army office that studied foreign weapons, was "trying to use recovered technology to use human brain waves to guide" long-range nuclear missiles, and he dates this to about 1958 to 1962. If true, it would mean crashed craft gave the military a way to control machines with the mind.
